content:
The retail snapshot is as of 2025-12-31. Use only the certified customer_360 sources. Prefer MEASURE() on revenue_metrics and customer_health_metrics for every aggregate KPI. Revenue and LTV mean net on completed orders, unless gross is explicitly requested. Use the existing revenue_at_risk measure for regional exposure. Customer health region is the customer's home region. Order revenue region is the order store region.
Health segmentation uses completed-order recency, frequency and monetary value. Apply this precedence: Never ordered (zero completed orders), Champion (R >= 4 and F >= 4), At risk (R <= 2 and F >= 3), Loyal (F >= 3), Hibernating (R <= 2), Promising (remaining purchasers). Revenue at risk is the net LTV of customers in At risk. Active customers placed a completed order within 90 days of the snapshot.
For individual lookups use customer_profile, optionally joining customer_health by customer_id. Match names and emails case-insensitively. Use order_facts for customer orders with order_ts descending and order_id descending as a tie-breaker. Label currency as USD and rates as percentages.
